title: coprosma arnottiana
intro: Coprosma arnottiana, commonly known as Karamu, is a small, evergreen shrub native to New Zealand. It has been traditionally used by Maori people to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Karamu are attributed to its ability to act as a mild laxative, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic, making it useful in treating digestive issues, wounds, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Coprosma arnottiana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
